control.start: write ap_start through the generated control register
control.completion: ap_done; output is valid after ap_done and remains stable until the next start
control.idle_ready: ap_idle/ap_ready follow the standard Vitis HLS ap_ctrl_hs contract
control.invocation: one complete 14-convolution CNN inference per start

input.name: input_q14
input.layout: C-contiguous planar NCHW, R then G then B
input.precondition: already downsampled from the cropped [1,3,720,1272] full-resolution input using the frozen integer_downsample Q14 rule; CNN top does not perform image resize

weight_frac.layout: one fractional-bit value per output channel

output.name: a_low_q14
output.layout: C-contiguous planar NCHW, R then G then B

workspace.name: workspace_int16
workspace.layout: two 64-channel working slots followed by six 32-channel skip slots; stored fractional bits vary by layer
workspace.reuse_rule: must remain owned by this invocation until ap_done

memory_map.weight_offset_unit: elements of the declared pointer dtype
memory_map.output_address: byte address supplied in the a_low_q14 AXI-Lite pointer register
memory_map.cache_rule: flush input/weights/bias/frac/LUT before start; invalidate A_low after ap_done; invalidate workspace only if PS reads it
memory_map.alias_rule: input, model arrays, output, and workspace must occupy disjoint DDR regions
